guynmart_100.m:
Then you must open the gate! Go to the gatehouse and open it, so that my men can get in. Be quick.
After that go to the farm south of here. I expect a ferocious battle.

guynmart_20.m: Good. At last. Go and bring Norgothla here.
r: Norgothla is out in the woods and awaits you there with his men. Unkorh persuaded him that you commanded that.

guynmart_30.m: Unkorh! I curse the day when I made him my steward.
r: How can I help you now? Shall I search for the keys to your cell?

guynmart_40.m: No time for that. I am too weak to be of much help. We need Norgothla now.
r: Lovis is on his way to him. He can probably persuade Norgothla to come to the castle.

guynmart_50.m: Good. Norgothla knows and trusts him. Tell me - is the main gate shut?
r: Yes. I came through the garden door.

guynmart_steward4_120.m: Indeed. I am surprised to see you here.

guynmart_steward4_122.m: I wanted to keep you out of all this. I'm sure you now have many questions. I will tell you everything.
r: I hope you have a good explanation.
I don't want to hear your lies.

guynmart_steward4_124.m: Please be patient, and give me a minute. This may be important to you.
r: No. I will never believe you unless you let Guynmart go!

guynmart_steward4_130.m: Until recently, everything was fine. Guynmart was a righteous man, open-minded and tolerant. And Hannah was supposed to marry me when she was old enough.

guynmart_steward4_140.m: Then one unfortunate day this Lovis appeared.

guynmart_steward4_142.m: He kept playing on his probably magical flute and thus stole Hannah's heart.

guynmart_steward4_144.m: He also began to influence Guynmart more and more, until Guynmart would not make a single decision without hearing from Lovis.

guynmart_steward4_150.m: Shadow meetings were banned, and the use of bonemeal potions was prohibited.

guynmart_steward4_152.m: People had to hand over all their bonemeal supplies so that they could be destroyed. The farms, their inhabitants, and even visitors were searched.

guynmart_steward4_160.m: A young man, who was my guest at that time, gave me his bonemeal potion box and asked me to take care of it. Otherwise it would have been destroyed too.

guynmart_steward4_162.m: So I took it for safekeeping. Look here.
r: I know this box - it belongs to my brother Andor!

guynmart_steward4_164.m: Andor - yes, that was his name. He is your brother? That explains the similarity.

guynmart_steward4_166.m: We had long nights of interesting conversation.

guynmart_steward4_170.m: Well, Andor had to go on urgent business and left the castle the same night.

guynmart_steward4_20.m: I have had enough of you. This will be your end!
r: Oh dear. Have mercy, please. I am just a little kid.

guynmart_steward4_200.m: Enough talk. Now you have to decide if you want to trust me or rather Guynmart.
r: I think I misjudged you. I will trust you.
You did not convince me. I believe Guynmart more than you.

guynmart_steward4_202.m: Are you sure? Listen to your heart. It is really important.
r: No, I believe Guynmart more than you.

guynmart_steward4_220.m: Guynmart tried to get at you from behind. I felt I had to do something quick, but it seems that it wasn't necessary. Obviously he stumbled and fell on his own knife.
r: Thank you. Really, I didn't expect this from Lord Guynmart.

guynmart_steward4_230.m: Yes, Guynmart had changed a lot recently. Here, please take Andor's bonemeal potion box and return it to him.
r: If only I had finally found my brother.

guynmart_steward4_290.m: And now stick to your plan. Open the gate. My men will await Norgothla.

guynmart_steward4_292.m: Then go to the farm south of here and stay there for the night. May The Shadow be with you!

guynmart_steward4_30.m: Now you will get what you deserve!
r: No, please, please don't hurt me!

guynmart_steward4_32.m: Pathetic. So run, and never let me set eyes on you again!

guynmart_steward4_50.m: What did you call me? I'll beat you until you whine for mercy.
r: Ha! So come on and try! No? I will put an end to you now!
Oh dear, please forgive my rash words.

guynmart_steward4_60.m: OK. I will go now. But I will not forget you - fear my revenge! And before I leave, I will stab your beloved Guynmart...
r: Nooo! What did you do? Stay and face me, you coward!

guynmart.10: On a farm I heard of Guynmart Castle nearby. The farmer Rhodita is worried about young Lady Hannah of Guynmart, who used to visit often but has not been seen for a week now. Rhodita asked me to check on her.
guynmart.16: I got to the castle, but the main gate was shut.
guynmart.18: I got to the castle, but the main gate was shut.
guynmart.20: I found the way into the castle garden.
guynmart.30: The guard at the back door is corrupt. He agreed to let me through for some gold.
guynmart.32: He told me who is living at the castle: Guynmart himself, and his children Hannah and Robalyrius.
guynmart.40: In the main hall I met Unkorh the steward. He expected Guynmart to return the following morning. He says I should go to the kitchen for some bread and then leave.
guynmart.45: I met Lady Hannah's little brother, Rob.
guynmart.50: The maid told me that Hannah is missing her betrothed. I should talk to Hannah; she is on the tower top. To get to her, I should offer the cook to take Hannah her lunch.
guynmart.60: I overheard Unkorh the steward talking to himself. He plans for Guynmart to die in the castle dungeon, and after ursuping the throne he would marry Lady Hannah.
guynmart.62: I suggested to Hofala the cook that I could take some lunch to Lady Hannah. He had no more of his special herb selection for the lunch and asked me to get some fresh herbs from Nuik in the garden.
guynmart.63: Nuik gave some herbs to me.
guynmart.64: I should take lunch to Lady Hannah on the tower top.
guynmart.70: Hannah is filled with grief, she cannot think clearly without the smell of a rose. Before she can tell me her whole story, she needs a fresh, fragrant rose.
guynmart.80: Unkorh saw me talking to Hannah. He was very jealous and asked guard Olav to show me the special guest exit.
guynmart.81: I met Norgothla, the chief of Guynmart's personal guard. He was troubled about my news from the castle, and asked me to get evidence for it.
guynmart.82: I got the rose from the guard at the garden door at last.
guynmart.90: I gave the rose to Hannah. She told me that Lovis has vanished. In the deepenst depths of her darkest dreams she hears Lovis' voice calling out.
guynmart.100: Hannah gave Lovis' flute to me, so that I might prove that I was sent by Hannah.
guynmart.110: I met Rob in a room above the watch chamber. Rob promised to distract the guards so that I could pass by.
guynmart.120: 120 obsolete - The guards were distracted and would not see anybody climbing downstairs.
guynmart.130: 130 obsolete - I jumped into the dark dungeon below the tower.
guynmart.132: I jumped into the dark dungeon below the tower where I found Lovis. He was overjoyed to get back his flute.
guynmart.134: The dungeon door flew open. The torturer entered and demanded that we stop the noise.
guynmart.136: After the torturer's death the door was open.
guynmart.140: Lovis left and went into the woods to get Guynmart's personal guards.
guynmart.160: Guynmart was laying half dead in a cell. He asked me to open the castle gate so that his personal guard may come in. After that I should run and hide, because there would be a dangerous battle. I should not return before the following morning.
guynmart.161: Unkorh appeared and explained many things. Then Unkorh saw that Guynmart tried to kill me from behind, but stumbled and fell onto his own knife. I should still open the gate, and then go to the farm in the south until the morning.
guynmart.162: Unkorh appeared and killed Guynmart. Then he fled like a coward.
guynmart.163: The guards let me through to the wall.
guynmart.164: I got the main gate open.
guynmart.170: I went to Rhodita the farmer and stayed there for the night.
guynmart.180: When I got to the castle on the next day, I saw Hannah and Lovis in the throne room. The castle was decorated for a wedding and there had been a merry feast.
guynmart.181: When I got to the castle on the next day, I saw Unkorh the steward in the throne room. The castle was decorated for a wedding and there had been a merry feast.
guynmart.190: Hannah gave me an everlasting fragrant rose as a present.
guynmart.200: I was allowed to choose something from the treasury.
guynmart.202: I took the scroll of wisdom.
guynmart.210: Lovis prepared a surprise for me east of the castle.
guynmart.211: Then I took my leave of Unkorh.

andor.1: My father Mikhail says that Andor has not been home since yesterday. I should go look for him in the village.
andor.10: Leonid tells me that he saw Andor talking to Gruil. I should go ask Gruil if he knows more.
andor.20: Gruil wants me to bring him a poison gland. Then he might talk more. He tells me that some poisonous snakes have such a gland.
andor.30: Gruil tells me that Andor was looking for someone called Umar. I should go ask his friend Gaela in Fallhaven to the east.
andor.40: I talked to Gaela in Fallhaven. He tells me to go see Bucus and ask about the Thieves' Guild.
andor.50: Bucus has allowed me to enter the hatch in the derelict house in Fallhaven. I should go talk to Umar.
andor.51: Umar in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild recognized me, but must have me confused with Andor. Apparently, Andor has been to see him.
andor.55: Umar told me that Andor went to see a potion maker called Lodar. I should search for his hideaway.
andor.61: I heard a story in Loneford, where it seemed like Andor had been in Loneford, and that he might have had something to do with the illness that the people are suffering from there. I am not sure if it actually was Andor. If it was Andor, why would he have made the people of Loneford ill?
andor.62: Andor might have gone to do some business with a rich man in Brimhaven after he left Loneford.
andor.65: It looks like Andor was involved in the destruction of the Brimhaven dam.
andor.70: I have found the potion-maker Lodar, and heard his story about Andor. Andor went to visit Lodar in his hideaway to get a sample of something called Narwood extract. Lodar happened to notice that there was someone travelling together with Andor, that hid among the trees and did not seem to want Lodar to spot him.
andor.71: Shortly after Andor and the person he was travelling with had left, strange things started to happen in the woods around Lodar's hideaway, and Lodar himself seemed to be affected by it somehow. Lodar believes that something disturbed the tomb below his cabin, and awoke the Hira'zinn.
andor.72: Since I helped Lodar defeat the Hira'zinn, he promised to help me in return. He gave me a piece of paper that should allow me to enter the Valanyr temple of the Shadow in Nor City. He told me to seek out lady Lydalon in the temple for further assistance.
andor.80: All clues so far as to where Andor went point to Nor City. I should travel to Nor City by following the Duleian road to the southeast and look for more clues there.
andor.85: Andor may have been in Stoutford.
andor.86: Andor had something to do with the demon under the church in Stoutford.
andor.90: At Castle Guynmart I learned from Steward Unkorh that some time ago Andor was also there as a guest.
andor.92: Unkorh gave me the bonemeal potion box that Andor had given him for safekeeping.
andor.100: While exploring the town of Sullengard, I so happened to stumble upon my mother and my aunt to whom I have never met. Mother has insisted that I go home so we can talk.
andor.110: After talking with mother back at home, she and I tried to brainstorm about where Andor could be. She reminded me about Andor's friend Stanwick who lives in Brightport. We agreed that going to talk to him might be the next logical thing to do.
andor.120: In the dungeons of Laeroth manor, Kotheses, the torturer, mentioned that he had taught Andor the basics of torturing.
andor.125: Vaelric confirmed that Andor visited him recently. Andor sought to learn Vaelric's skills and left quickly, clutching what he came for. His actions raise more questions about his intentions.
andor.126: In Brightport, I was finally able to meet Stanwick, but due to his hazy memory, he was not able to help me learn anything about the whereabouts of Andor.
andor.127: Regaining his peace of mind after I helped him, Stanwick said he'll tell me more about Andor, once he gathers his thoughts.
andor.128: Stanwick gave me a signet ring that I should show to his father. Jorwick, in Nor City.
andor.130: Andor was trying to find out from Seraphina about terrible monsters in the hideout near the place with the larval burrowers.
andor.131: Elysa in the Brightport's thieves guild told me that Andor has bought a map to the sewers of Feygard.
andor.132: While investigating the Brightport theft I learned from Bryma that Andor was the one who stole the important document, and brought it to her in exchange for her alchemy knowledge.
andor.140: I saw Andor in the mountains of Galmore. We were able to exchange a few words before he disappeared again.
andor.145: I met Andor on the road to Feygard, where he was buying food from Rosmara. He disappeared again.
andor.147: I met Andor on the road to Nor City, where he was buying supplies from Alynndir. He disappeared again.
andor.910: I decided to settle down on the top of Mt. Galmore. For this I needed to find a rich and discreet man to rebuild the ruins according to my wishes. Andor will now have to go and find himself.
andor.912: The construction contract for my new home was completed. I was curious to see what it would look like.
andor.914: I visited my new residence on the top of Mt. Galmore. There I would help the people of Dhayavar as a hero and protect them from villains. Or would I become a villain myself? We'll see.
andor.999: [Quest is not completable at this time.]

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
